parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human histone acetyltransferase KAT2A. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require structures. Filter where target_dictionary.pref_name is 'histone acetyltransferase KAT2A' and target_dictionary.organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
